description: This file implements the source code for the CJ125 sensor interface, including SPI communication with the CJ125 device, reading ADC inputs, calibration routines, heater control, and sensor data interpolation. It appears to be part of a larger embedded system for engine control, handling sensor data acquisition and processing.

classes.name: RealSpi
classes.description: A class implementing the Cj125SpiStream interface for SPI register read/write operations.

classes.name: CJ125
classes.description: A class representing the CJ125 sensor, managing the calibration, mode setting, and error handling.

methods.name: cjReadRegister
methods.description: Reads a register from the CJ125 via SPI.

methods.name: cjWriteRegister
methods.description: Writes a value to a register in the CJ125 via SPI.

methods.name: getUr
methods.description: Reads the Ur voltage from ADC or internal measurement.

methods.name: getUa
methods.description: Reads the Ua voltage from ADC or internal measurement.

methods.name: cjPrintData
methods.description: Outputs current sensor data for debugging.

methods.name: cjPrintErrorCode
methods.description: Outputs the error message corresponding to an error code.

methods.name: cjUpdateAnalogValues
methods.description: Updates the instantaneous analog voltage readings for Ur and Ua.

methods.name: cjCalibrate
methods.description: Performs sensor calibration routine, storing calibration data.

methods.name: cjStart
methods.description: Initializes the CJ125 sensor, performing calibration if necessary.

methods.name: setError
methods.description: Sets an error state with a corresponding message.

methods.name: cj125periodic
methods.description: Main periodic task managing sensor state and heater control.

methods.name: cjGetAfr
methods.description: Interprets sensor data to estimate the air-fuel ratio (AFR).

methods.name: cjHasAfrSensor
methods.description: Checks if the sensor and sensor module are available and operational.

methods.name: initCJ125
methods.description: Initializes the CJ125 sensor module, setups SPI and calibration.
